name: @appetitebind/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Appetitebind (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && for d in identity usecases appetite fairness assessments controls monitoring predictions governance; do redocly bundle $d --output src/.bundled/$d.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle $d --output src/.bundled/$d.json; done
